% Pattern: case/manual/article. Bold case heads in a proof are items, of the
% kind other/case, and they do not end the proof they are in. A plain
% "Case 3:" in a sentence is not an item.
% from 0807.1620, 1006.4470
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want head-1 other/case 1
% want head-2 other/case 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
Each tree with two nodes is a path.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
There are two cases.

\textbf{Case 1.} The tree has one edge. Then it is a path.

\textbf{Case 2.} The tree has no edge. Case 3: there is none.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
